exposure: Psychosocial characteristics (cultural context, emotional well-being, resource availability)
Social and obstetric history (previous miscarriage, previous C-section, maternal age, gestational age)
Psychological variables (resilience, positive and negative affect, derailment, maternity beliefs)
Mode of birth in most recent labor (C-section)
cohort: The participants were 185 women who received maternity-related healthcare in Spain or Colombia.
finding: The perception of maternity rights fulfillment depends on socio-healthcare contexts, women's age, obstetric history, and resource availability.
mod_finding: Giving birth via C-section in the most recent labor was a negative predictor for the fulfillment of maternity rights, while having a previous C-section was identified as a positive predictor.
gest_age: Gestational age was included as a positive predictor variable in the analysis.
